rationale_ko: 094는 전체 고오차군과 형태 대조에서 일반화 근거를 얻지 못했고097/099~111의 잡음·관측·구조 재시도도 실패했다. 새 표현 학습을 정당화할 근거가 없어 요청된 대안인 미확인 감사로 진행했다. 이번 대상은 일반 고오차가 아니라 baseline 제거와 후속 재학습으로 생긴013→014 오차 변화다.
audit_question: Does baseline removal and downstream refitting from013 to014 have less favorable error changes under an image condition selected only from outer-training paired anchor errors? This tests transferable heterogeneity in the removal effect, not generic high-error imagery.

design.training_only_condition_selection: For each outer fold, assemble320 paired honest pre-physics base013/base014 anchor residuals from three B106/107 blocks. Each B anchor was fitted/calibrated exclusively on A213/214 with deeper142/143 fits. Fit one risk rule on320 training rows: each of12 columns has low25% and high25% tail using train-only linear quantile; eligible tail count15%-40%; compute delta=(y-anchor014)^2-(y-anchor013)^2; select maximum train tail-vs-rest mean delta contrast, deterministic fixed-order ties. Apply unchanged to outer80. No inner tuning of risk learner or new residual correction.
design.anchor_stage_limit: These are paired honest errors of smaller pre-physics013/014 anchors, not cross-fitted complete013/014 residual errors. Final014-minus013 outer loss changes are the primary evaluation; changes in the pre-physics bases are a stage diagnostic. Training-size and model-stage mismatch are explicit. Pooling320 anchor errors is safe for this fixed outer risk procedure, not permission to cross-validate models on pooled residual labels.
design.primary: Mean(delta014-minus013 | selected condition) minus mean(delta | other), pooled over3x400 pairs with only400 unique IDs; report actual013/014 RMSE and signed residual changes in each group. A positive contrast need not mean harm: both groups may improve. It is a prospective association audit, not improvement in prediction RMSE, causal evidence, or independent research validation.
design.uncertainty: 10000 paired ID cluster bootstrap draws seed20271105, all three predictions and risk flags travel together. Conditional on fitted rules/models; excludes adaptive research and refitting. No iid1200 inference or permutation p-value.

results.limits: These are paired honest errors of smaller pre-physics013/014 anchors, not cross-fitted complete013/014 residual errors. Final014-minus013 outer loss changes are the primary evaluation; changes in the pre-physics bases are a stage diagnostic. Training-size and model-stage mismatch are explicit. Pooling320 anchor errors is safe for this fixed outer risk procedure, not permission to cross-validate models on pooled residual labels. Same400 historically reused; conditional bootstrap does not validate causal image domains. No fitted prediction correction or claim of lower RMSE.

validation.scope: No upstream retraining; existing training intervention certificate reused. No holdout/test decoding, model correction, upload or cost.

interpretation_ko: 학습에서 선택된 조건의 평균 MSE 변화 대비는+12.9371이었지만 외부 최종014/013의 pooled 대비는-0.9838로 방향이 이어지지 않았다. 훈련 선택의 낙관성과 앵커 학습량·단계 차이가 섞여 있으므로 한 원인으로 단정하지 않는다.
선택 조건군과 나머지 모두014에서 개선됐고, 조건군-vs-나머지 차이의 이미지 묶음95% 구간[-8.2743,6.2945]은0을 포함한다. 선택 조건을 기반으로013을 복원하거나 별도 보정을 추가할 근거가 없다.
선택된 조건은15fold에서8종류였다. noise_contrast_ratio 낮음이5회였지만 전체400 결과를 보고 이를 새로운 고정 게이트로 고르면 추가 적응적 탐색이다. 이를 선택하거나 후속 점수를 계산하지 않았다.
이미지별014-013 제곱오차 변화의 재분할 간 Spearman은0.584~0.593이며 불리한 변화 상위40개 교집합은13~19개다. 개별 변화 일부는 반복되지만 형태·잡음 조건으로 안정적으로 설명됐다는 뜻은 아니다.
조건군의 재분할 간 Jaccard는0.223~0.274다. 원본·재분할의1200쌍을 독립 이미지로 다루지 않았고400개 ID 단위로 묶어 불확실성을 계산했다.

decision.reason: No supported nonduplicate image correction and no prospective adverse-condition transfer. Close this audit without posthoc threshold/feature/weight expansion.
decision.next_trigger: A distinct externally justified measurement/generator hypothesis or independent evidence would be needed before reopening these failed image-condition families. This is not a proof of a performance ceiling.

limitations: Same400 and known partitions have been used adaptively in earlier research. Nested current rule fitting does not erase historical model selection; all findings remain exploratory.

The train discovery target compares smaller pre-physics anchors; outer evaluation compares complete013/014 models including separately refitted residuals. Scope valid for outer evaluation, but not exact same-stage error transport.
Image noise, grain size, boundary and interior support are measurement proxies without true noise or segmentation labels. No causality or physical target invariance established.
Confidence intervals condition on fitted models/rules; no refitting or selection-adjusted uncertainty. Full400 top40 and feature-frequency summaries are descriptive only, never gates.
This single simple train-only rule family failing does not exclude more complex untested relationships; it does not justify automatic complexity or parameter expansion.
